label: Car insurance
tier_metric: Private passenger auto direct premiums written, 2024 (NAIC)
rule: Consumer-facing brand of each NAIC group; AAA clubs pooled into one unit; S = all remaining eligible ranks 15-25.

label: Hotel chains
tier_metric: US locations (ScrapeHero, ranks 1-10), then rooms (HOTELS 325) for further US brand-owning companies
rule: Master brand as named in the source; sub-brands are not aliases; management companies and consortia excluded; S = every 2nd of the remaining guest-facing brands in rooms order, starting with the first.

label: Grocery store chains
rule: Companies whose primary format is the supermarket or grocery store and whose name is a store banner; mass merchants, clubs and dollar stores excluded; S = all remaining.

label: Clothing and department stores
rule: Department, off-price and specialty apparel retailers in the NRF list; namesake or flagship banner; S = all remaining.

label: Pharmacies
tier_metric: 2025 prescription revenue (Drug Channels Institute); NRF 2025 US retail sales for the two independent-pharmacy networks
rule: Consumer-facing pharmacy brand of each ranked company; S = all remaining.

label: Convenience stores and gas stations
phase_b_noun: convenience store and gas station chains
rule: Chain name as store banner; holdings, distributors and multi-banner operators excluded (banner not established from the source); oil-major fuel brands excluded (count covers company-operated sites only); S = all remaining.

label: Fashion and luxury
tier_metric: Interbrand Best Global Brands 2026 brand value (luxury), then Lyst Index Q3 2026 rank for brands not in Interbrand
rule: Global sources (no US-only ranking found); ranks 1-8 from Interbrand by value, 9+ from Lyst order; S = all remaining.
